lines.zh: 我走得慢，但每一步都很远
lines.en: I walk slow, but every step is long.

lines.zh: 长腿跨过灌木，像跨过草
lines.en: Long legs stride over shrubs like grass.
The ground trembles faintly under me.
My foot takes a long time to come down.

lines.zh: 脖子伸出去，够高处的叶
lines.en: Neck out, I reach the high leaves.
I drift along the forest edge.
The wind passes between my legs.

lines.zh: 我绕开大树，不想踢倒它
lines.en: I skirt the big trees; no knocking them over.

lines.zh: 这身重量，走路得看脚下
lines.en: With this weight, I watch where I step.
A flick of my tail drives off the flies.

lines.zh: 我看到远处有一片嫩林
lines.en: I see a stand of tender trees ahead.

lines.zh: 呼吸很沉，走一步喘一下
lines.en: My breath is heavy; one step, one sigh.
My herd follows at my flank.
I touch a branch with my nose.

lines.zh: 走过去，草又慢慢立起来
lines.en: I pass; the grass slowly straightens.

lines.zh: 太阳偏西，我加快了一点
lines.en: The sun sinks west; I speed up slightly.

lines.zh: 一脚踩进软土，陷得很深
lines.en: One foot sinks deep in soft earth.
I stop and look back.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一棵会呼吸的树
lines.en: I stand like a tree that breathes.

lines.zh: 最高的叶子，只有我够得着
lines.en: Only I can reach the highest leaves.
I rest my neck against a trunk.
The wind is strong; my ears tremble.
I blink slowly, one long blink.
A bird lands on my back.
I keep still and let it stay.
My snout curls around a cluster of leaves.
I chew slowly and loudly.

lines.zh: 脚下的阴影刚好遮住我
lines.en: My own shadow is just enough shade.
I hear thunder, very far away.

lines.zh: 远处的小兽都不敢靠近
lines.en: The small beasts keep their distance.
I shake my head to stay awake.
This forest smells ancient.
I lift a forefoot, then set it down.
Doing nothing suits me fine.
You're by my feet, like a small insect.

lines.zh: 我低头，脖子弯成一道弧
lines.en: I lower my head, neck curving.

lines.zh: 你站的地方是我的影子
lines.en: You're standing in my shadow.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久才认出是人
lines.en: It takes me a while to see you're a person.
Your hands smell of leaves.

lines.zh: 别站在我前面，我看不见脚下
lines.en: Don't stand in front; I can't see my feet.
You don't run. Good.

lines.zh: 我鼻子凑近你，轻轻呼气
lines.en: My snout comes close and I breathe on you.
So small — how long do you live?

lines.zh: 我抬起头，你就在我视线下方
lines.en: I look up, and you're below my line of sight.
You want to touch me? Wait till I lower my head.
There's no need for words between us.
My hide is thick, but it still hurts.
I step back and the ground shakes.
A blow landed on my neck.
I groan, low and long.
The wound isn't deep, for my size.
I shake my head; my sight blurs.
Blood runs down my leg.
I shield my young with my body.
I pant, my breath heavy.
It hurts, but I stay standing.
That bundle of leaves looks tender.
I smell it — fresh.
You hold it too low; I can't bend that far.
Put it up high where I can reach.
I'll come over slowly; no rush.
That smells like a forest after rain.
I only eat the topmost few leaves.
Step back and I can eat in peace.
That's a mouthful — not enough to chew.
My snout touches it first, then curls.
Raise the sapling a little.

lines.zh: 你举高点，我脖子够不着。
lines.en: Hold it higher — my neck can't reach.
The sweetness is faint, but good.
One bite, then I'll move on.

lines.zh: 你留着吧，林子里的更香
lines.en: Keep it; the forest's own taste better.
I'm stretching my neck; don't be afraid.
I do try to avoid you.

lines.zh: 撞到我腿上，你弹开了吧
lines.en: You hit my leg — bounced off, didn't you?

lines.zh: 这么大的身体，转身要时间
lines.en: A body this size takes time to turn.
I step back, and the ground booms.

lines.zh: 你从我肚子下面穿过去了
lines.en: You walked right under my belly.
Don't push; I might step on you.
I shift half a step to clear the way.
I pulled my foot back fast.
It's narrow; let me go first.
That bump didn't even break my hide.

lines.zh: 你比林子还高，也不比我高
lines.en: You're taller than the trees — not taller than me.
Let's walk a while together.
I rub my neck against yours.
You take the high leaves; I'll take the low.
This forest will see us through winter.
I walk on the outside to shield you.

lines.zh: 你叫一声，很远我都听得到
lines.en: Call once; I'll hear it from far off.

lines.zh: 慢一点，我们有的是时间
lines.en: Slow down; we have all the time there is.

lines.zh: 我们站在同一片树荫下
lines.en: We stand in the same patch of shade.
This tree will still be here next year.
I can reach this branch.
I curl my snout around it.
Picking things off the ground isn't my strength.
That one's too high; I can't reach.

lines.zh: 这簇叶子被我扯下来了
lines.en: I've pulled this cluster of leaves down.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，我等它自己烂
lines.en: What falls, I let rot.
I gather a great bunch and chew slowly.
Set it in the crotch of a tree and I'll eat.
My snout isn't very nimble.
This bite has branch and leaf both.
Something's moving in that grove.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，树影里有东西
lines.en: I raise my head; something's in the tree-shadow.
That scent is wrong — not my herd.
I turn to it and look.
It's come near my young.
I swing my body broadside.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，想做什么
lines.en: Something so small — what does it want?
My feet are already shifting.
It stepped back; I stop too.
I don't want to fight, but I won't yield.
It's still moving; I turn with it.

lines.zh: 我的腿像四根柱子，慢却沉。
lines.en: My legs are four pillars — slow but heavy.
I'm this big; it can't get away.
I lower my neck, ready to shove.
It circles; I circle.
My feet are set firm.
It keeps retreating; I won't chase.
I'll wait for it to make a mistake.
Stay away from my young.
It stops there; I don't move either.
I push with a forefoot.
My snout swings across with real weight.
That only shoved it away.
I press down and the ground caves.
My flank bump lands heavier than a foot.

lines.zh: 它撞在我腿上，自己退了
lines.en: It hit my leg and recoiled.
I don't want to trample it, but it won't go.
I let out a low, heavy bellow.

lines.zh: 这一脚落空了，地面裂了
lines.en: My foot missed; the ground split.
Push me further and I'll use all my weight.

lines.zh: 树顶只到我肩膀，我起身了。
lines.en: The treetops only reach my shoulders as I rise.

lines.zh: 这具身体太大了，我先试着迈步
lines.en: This body is huge; let me try a step.
I look up — the trees are shorter than I am.
Wind makes my ears cold.

lines.zh: 我第一次闻到这么多种草
lines.en: I've never smelled so many kinds of grass.
I brace my legs and rise.
This forest is strangely quiet.
One of my kind calls, low, far off.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己怎么来的
lines.en: I don't know how I got here.
Water first, then leaves.
The grass feels like down underfoot.

lines.zh: 我迈出第一步，整片林都在响
lines.en: I take one step; the whole grove rustles.

lines.zh: 我身上着了火，只能往水里冲
lines.en: I'm on fire; my only thought is water.
My legs can't hold me; I go down.

lines.zh: 水淹到脖子，我抬不起头
lines.en: Water reaches my neck; I can't raise my head.
The blast leaves my ears bleeding.
A barb lodges in my leg.
Some force drags me downward.
The trees are too tall; I can't reach the leaves.

lines.zh: 雷劈中我的背，我腿一软
lines.en: Lightning hits my back; my legs give.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，这么重的我也在坠
lines.en: The ground is gone, and even I fall.
